initial_question.rag_input: Which exact Producers Guild award category was given to both Game of Thrones season 2 and Stranger Things?
initial_question.question: Which exact Producers Guild award category was given to both Game of Thrones season 2 and Stranger Things?
initial_question.answer: Both shows received the Norman Felton Award for Outstanding Producer of Episodic Television, Drama.
